links.targetTitle: Grove takes accounting ownership of the Peg Stability Module

title: Grove's Artifact documents inherited Sky Core infrastructure whose control and governing parameters still sit elsewhere
content:
A.6.1.1.2.3.4.1 records that "**Control of the Andromeda RWA Arranged Structure is currently being transitioned to Grove**" — an inherited structure allocating into short-term treasury strategies of under one year duration — while A.6.1.1.2.3.4.1.1 points to its parameters at A.3.2.7.2.1, outside Grove's Artifact, and A.6.1.1.2.3.4.1.2 states that "**future iterations** of the Artifact will specify operational processes owned by Grove."

The Lite Peg Stability Module is in the same state. A.6.1.1.2.3.4.2 declares control "currently being transitioned," A.6.1.1.2.3.4.2.1 places its parameters "in the Sky Core Atlas," and A.6.1.1.2.3.4.2.2.1 is explicit about the split: "The **Sky Core Facilitator currently owns** the process for modifying the parameters of the Lite PSM, which process is defined in the Sky Core Atlas. This process is currently being transitioned over to Grove."

So for these two pieces of infrastructure, three things that normally coincide are separated: the Artifact that describes them (Grove's), the Atlas that governs their parameters (Sky Core's), and the party who may change those parameters (the Sky Core Facilitator). Grove's Artifact asserts a claim on assets it does not yet operate.

The honesty is worth crediting — the transition is disclosed rather than glossed, and each pointer names where authority actually lives. But a reader consulting Grove's Artifact to understand the Lite PSM finds only a forwarding address, and one consulting it to find out who may act during an incident finds an answer that is explicitly temporary and undated.

The Lite PSM makes this concrete. It is peg infrastructure, directly load-bearing for USDS — the very thing Strategic Intent names as Grove's purpose. Its handover is governed by Ecosystem Accord 2 (A.2.8.2.2) rather than by either party's own Artifact, which is the mechanism that makes a transfer of authority between Agents binding on both.
description: Andromeda and the Lite PSM are 'currently being transitioned' to Grove while their parameters remain defined in the Sky Core Atlas and the Sky Core Facilitator still owns the modification process.
